calibration: Grid search over 100 temperature values [0.5, 5.0] on validation set
training_data: PURUTT (72.7k) + synthetic scam (1.5k) + supplementary datasets, ~80k total after dedup
notes: High precision (97.0%) reflects deliberate design choice to minimize false positives. Recall (75.6%) is the known gap — model is conservative on borderline cases. Class-weighted loss compensates for toxic/clean imbalance without resampling.
